description: This is a Java source file containing unit tests for the GrantRevokeIndex class, which manages permission granting and revoking logic within a trie-based enforcers system. The tests verify correct equality, permission checks, and handling of permission updates.

classes.name: GrantRevokeIndexTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the GrantRevokeIndex class, implementing test cases for equality, permission checks, and permission updates.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Sets up static test constants such as subject IDs and permissions.

methods.name: initTestVariables
methods.description: Initializes instance variables before each test, including granted and revoked permission maps and the index under test.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations for GrantRevokeIndex.

methods.name: getGrantedReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that getGranted() returns the expected map.

methods.name: getRevokedReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that getRevoked() returns the expected map.

methods.name: copyWithDecrementedWeightReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that copying the index with decremented weights produces the correct maps.

methods.name: tryToOverrideByNull
methods.description: Ensures that overriding with null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: overrideByReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests the overrideBy method for correct merging of permission maps.

methods.name: subjectIdHasReadAndWritePermissions
methods.description: Checks that a subject with permissions hasPermissions returns true.

methods.name: anotherSubjectIdHasNoWritePermission
methods.description: Checks that a subject without write permission hasPermissions returns false.

methods.name: anotherSubjectIdHasNoReadPermissionBecauseRevokedWithSameWeight
methods.description: Checks that revoked permissions are correctly handled.

methods.name: getEffectedSubjectIdsForReadPermissionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the correct affected subject IDs for read permissions.

methods.name: getEffectedSubjectIdsForWritePermissionReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the correct affected subject IDs for write permissions.
